stages.name: preflight
stages.pass: Verified disposable Sandbox, supported profile, artifact and selected cache integrity

stages.name: installer
stages.pass: Security: unchanged enforcement rejects unsigned EXE with correlated Code Integrity event. Functional: fresh install and binary presence; full lifecycle when explicitly requested

stages.name: desktop
stages.pass: Installed Start Menu shortcut opens actual WinForms/WebView2; setup wizard and component diagnostics render

stages.name: whisper
inputs: pinned official Whisper revision and hashes or explicit network download
stages.pass: UI model setup, fresh CPU readiness, actual MP4 transcription with nonempty timestamped segments; short WAV probe unless exact prior proof applies
stages.method: WebView2 CDP pointer/DOM; read-only API evidence

stages.name: ollama-install
inputs: pinned signed official installer cache object
stages.pass: Valid Ollama signature, unattended install, local service version, UI status
stages.method: guest preparation CLI plus actual application UI

stages.name: ollama-model
inputs: verified model cache or explicit network pull
stages.pass: Model physically present with digest; selected and connected through application UI
stages.method: guest preparation CLI plus actual application UI

stages.name: ollama-inference
stages.pass: Real completed nonempty generation; records device-independent timing and raw response
stages.method: diagnostic HTTP API; does not claim UI generation

stages.name: translation
stages.pass: UI action completes separate translation job; saved nonempty Russian text, no translation errors, exported SRT with timestamps
stages.method: WebView2 CDP pointer/DOM; read-only saved-file evidence

stages.name: notes
stages.pass: UI notes action completes; nonempty saved notes and translation; report HTML persists
stages.method: WebView2 CDP pointer/DOM; read-only saved-file evidence

stages.name: cleanup
stages.pass: Application processes confined to this guest installation disposed; reports preserved
